svg.title: ROLI Piano overhead hardware diagram
svg.desc: Original simplified top-down line drawing; positions are illustrative, not mechanical dimensions. Each physical control has a stable device-prefixed ID and data-part name; standalone buttons are disabled until a host adds input handlers. Transparent regions marked data-surface-control are the profile's MIDI hit areas, and several can share one context-dependent control.
